title_ja: メットライフ・インベスト・マネジメント、パインブリッジを買収
title_en: MetLife Investment Management to acquire PineBridge
summary_en: MetLife Insurance K.K. released a Japanese summary on 26 Dec 2024 of MetLife, Inc.'s 23 Dec announcement. MetLife Investment Management (MIM) has agreed to buy Pinebridge Investments, a global asset manager with about $100bn under management, from Pacific Century Group. The price is $800m at closing, $200m tied to 2025 performance targets, and $200m in multi-year earn-outs. Pinebridge's private equity fund group and its China joint venture are excluded. MIM's assets under management would exceed $700bn. Completion is targeted for 2025, subject to regulatory approval.

title_en: Arrest of a former employee of the company
summary_en: MetLife Insurance (メットライフ生命) announced on 31 January 2025 that a former employee in their 40s was arrested for fraud. The person is suspected of forging claim documents on their own insurance policy to obtain insurance money from an insurer. The company learned of the case in June 2024, gave information to the police, and confirmed the arrest on 5 November 2024. It held off announcing until now because related investigations were still under way. It says no harm to its customers has been confirmed, and it set up a call center for anyone with concerns.

title_en: Ransomware damage at a contracted agency
summary_en:
MetLife Life Insurance (メットライフ生命) announced on 2027-02-27 that its outsourced agency group, Hoken Minaoshi Honpo Group, reported a ransomware attack. The group became aware of it on 2025-02-16 and cut the affected servers off from the network. MetLife has outsourced life insurance sales to four of the group's companies. It has found no leak of its customers' information so far, and its investigation is continuing.

Correction: the announcement is dated 2025-02-27, not 2027-02-27.

title_ja: メットライフ生命、一時払終身保険「サニーガーデン プライム」を発売
title_en: MetLife Japan launches single-premium whole life insurance 'Sunny Garden Prime'
summary_en: MetLife Life Insurance (メットライフ生命) announced on 30 March 2026 that it will launch the single-premium whole life product "Sunny Garden Prime" on 1 April 2026 through financial institution agencies. Its own consultant direct-sales channel and insurance agency channels are scheduled to follow on 1 July. The product renews "Sunny Garden EX" and adds a yen-denominated plan alongside US dollar. It also offers a choice of interest-rate guarantee periods, three courses for taking investment returns, and a flexible payee for the regular payments.

Staff it had seconded to agencies had obtained internal information without the agencies' permission, covering 2,476 items at 36 agencies between April 2021 and October 2025. Some of the material contained personal data. The company found no explicit instruction to obtain it, no use of it in sales or product development, and no sharing outside the company. summary_en: MetLife Insurance K.K. announced on 29 June 2026 that from 1 July it will sell its single-premium whole life product "Sunny Garden Prime" through its own sales employees and nationwide insurance agency channels.
